thread.title: Has Facebook's Stock Finally Turned The Corner?

author: Nelson Wang
title: Has Facebook's Stock Finally Turned The Corner?
text:
Facebook ( FB ) had a 2018 to forget amidst data and privacy scandals that tarnished its reputation and caused its stock to plunge.
But in its latest earnings report, it reported an extremely robust fourth quarter with revenue, profit and user gains that sent its stock soaring 11% on Thursday. CEO Mark Zuckerberg vowed on the call with analysts to focus again on innovation and products in 2019, rather than primarily on fixing its security practices, and said "we now have a clear sense of the path ahead."
Is the social network back on track for business and stock market gains more typical of its past?
